stories.title: Deeside Industrial Park 20mph limit set to be reversed on most roads
stories.summary: Roads across Deeside Industrial Park will return to 30mph from 16 October, reversing the 20mph limit brought in under Wales’ default speed limit in 2023. Flintshire County Council has made an order raising the limit on First, Second, Fourth, Sixth and Tenth avenues, Parkway and its roundabouts, and Drives A, B, C and D. Third

stories.title: Diesel close to all-time high as Fflint Wrecsam MS questions Welsh Government on fuel
stories.summary: Fflint Wrecsam MS Nigel Williams says he has asked the Welsh Government whether it has raised fuel prices with retailers and the UK Government, as diesel nears a record high. The average price of a litre of diesel reached 198.32p on Friday, according to the RAC, less than a penny short of the all-time high

stories.title: MS raises Flintshire Catholic school closures in the Senedd ahead of special Cabinet meeting
stories.summary: Sam Rowlands MS has urged Flintshire’s Cabinet to scrap plans to close four Catholic schools and build a 3-18 super-school in Flint. Mr Rowlands, a Welsh Conservative Member of the Senedd for Fflint Wrecsam, said the council’s Cabinet was due to consider the plans again. A special meeting of Flintshire County Council’s Cabinet is scheduled

stories.title: Late Hawarden resident Kay Sheargold describes Enigma work in newly released film
stories.summary: A filmed interview in which the late Kay Sheargold of Hawarden describes her wartime work as a Wren at Bletchley Park has been made public, 14 years after it was recorded. Flintshire filmmaker and social historian John Butler recorded the interview in 2012 and uploaded the latest episode to People’s Collection Wales on 18 September.

stories.title: Appeal after Kawasaki Mule utility vehicle stolen in Deeside
stories.summary: A green Kawasaki Mule utility vehicle was stolen from the Kelsterton area of Deeside during the night of Thursday 17 September, North Wales Police has said. Its registration is DK25 AZZ. The force’s Rural Crime Team is asking anyone who saw suspicious people, vehicles or activity in the area around the time of the theft
